name: Due Diligence API
shortDescription: Assess company risk, founders, financials, legal exposure, and compliance in one call
description: Run comprehensive due diligence on any company — score risk across financial, legal, operational, reputational, and regulatory dimensions. Analyze founder track records, check GDPR/SOX/AML compliance, assess litigation exposure, and generate a full recommendation. Designed for autonomous investment agents, M&A research workflows, and procurement intelligence platforms.

endpointPricing.description: Score company risk across financial, legal, operational, reputational, and regulatory dimensions
Analyze founder/team track record, domain expertise, red flags, and execution risk
Check GDPR, SOX, AML, KYC, ISO27001, HIPAA, PCI compliance status with gap analysis
Score company reputation with controversies, media sentiment, and brand health trend
Assess revenue trend, profitability, burn rate, runway, and unit economics signals
Identify active litigation, IP issues, regulatory investigations, and legal risk score
Validate due diligence input and recommend best analysis endpoint
ONE-CALL full due diligence — risk, financials, legal, compliance, founders, and recommendation
